metadata.defaultDescription: WorldFlavors is a global food culture platform featuring classic recipes, cooking techniques and cultural stories from Asia, Southeast Asia, Europe, the Americas, Africa and Oceania.

continentDescriptions.asia: From the profound depth of Chinese cuisine to the refined craft of Japanese cooking, Asia is where our journey begins.
continentDescriptions.southeast-asia: A collision of spices and tropical flair, where sour, spicy, sweet and salty blend in perfect harmony.
continentDescriptions.europe: From sunny Mediterranean flavors to French elegance, Europe is the cradle of Western culinary art.
continentDescriptions.americas: Native New World ingredients meet immigrant cultures — American cuisine is bold and vibrant.
continentDescriptions.africa: Ancient spice routes and tribal traditions give African flavors their rustic intensity.
continentDescriptions.oceania: Where immigrant and indigenous cultures meet, Oceanian cuisine is fresh and creative.

countryDescriptions.china: Eight great regional cuisines and countless techniques — Chinese food culture prizes color, aroma, taste and form.
countryDescriptions.japan: Japanese cuisine honors the natural flavor of ingredients and the rhythm of the seasons.
countryDescriptions.korea: The art of fermentation and chili paste — Korean cuisine is famed for kimchi, doenjang and BBQ culture, balancing five colors and five flavors.
countryDescriptions.thailand: Thai food is the art of balancing five flavors: sour, spicy, sweet, salty and bitter.
countryDescriptions.vietnam: Fresh herbs and fish sauce seasoning — Vietnamese cuisine blends French flair with Southeast Asian character.
countryDescriptions.italy: Simple ingredients, great flavors — Italian cooking is rooted in regional tradition and family warmth.
countryDescriptions.france: Hailed as the crown of Western cuisine, French cooking lives and breathes through its sauces and techniques.
countryDescriptions.mexico: The homeland of corn, chili and chocolate — Mexican cuisine is a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage.
countryDescriptions.peru: Blessed by the Andes and the Pacific, Peru is a shining jewel of South American gastronomy.
countryDescriptions.morocco: North Africa's spice kingdom, where tagines slowly stew Arab and Berber cultures together.
countryDescriptions.australia: Immigrant cultures meet native ingredients — Australia is a playground of modern fusion cuisine.

about.title: About Us
about.storyTitle: Our Story: It Started with Two Pizzas
about.story1: On May 22, 2010, programmer Laszlo Hanyecz bought two pizzas for 10,000 BTC — the day later known as "Bitcoin Pizza Day".
about.story2: It was the first time in history that a virtual currency was used to buy a real-world good, giving crypto its first anchor of value.
about.story3: WorldFlavors carries on this spirit: making the world's cuisines purchasable, unlockable and shareable with crypto.
about.story4: We start from Asia and will expand to the whole world, turning every dish into a cultural code that connects people.
about.missionDesc: WorldFlavors believes every dish is a cultural code of its people. With bilingual content, structured recipes and deep cultural stories, we help everyone recreate the flavors of the world.
about.visionDesc: Starting from Asia, expanding through Southeast Asia, Europe, the Americas and Africa — building a culinary gene bank for all humankind.
about.roadmap1: Phase 1: Deep dive into Asian & Southeast Asian cuisines (in progress)
about.roadmap2: Phase 2: Expand to classic European and American cuisines
about.roadmap3: Phase 3: Cover Africa & Oceania; integrate on-chain certification and DAO governance
about.teamDesc: We are engineers, editors and food lovers who believe in food and technology.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how WorldFlavors collects, uses, stores and protects your personal information. By using this website, you agree to the data practices described in this policy.
privacy.s1Body: We may collect the following information: access logs as you browse (IP address, browser type, timestamps); information you voluntarily provide (such as your name and email submitted via the contact form); and basic account information when registration becomes available. We collect only the minimum information necessary to provide our services.
privacy.s2Body: Collected information is used to: provide, maintain and improve our services; respond to your inquiries and feedback; analyze site usage to optimize content; and prevent fraud and abuse. We never sell your personal information to third parties.
privacy.s3Body: This site uses browser local storage to save your language preference and favorite recipes. This data stays on your device and is never uploaded to our servers. Cookies may be introduced when analytics services are added, with prior notice.
privacy.s4Body: We may use third-party services to host the site (e.g. Vercel), analyze traffic, or process payments (planned). These providers only access information necessary to perform their duties and are governed by their own privacy policies.
privacy.s5Body: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information, including HTTPS encryption and access controls. However, no transmission over the internet can be guaranteed to be absolutely secure.
privacy.s6Body: You have the right to access, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you, and to withdraw consent or file a complaint. Data stored in your browser can be deleted at any time by clearing your browser data.
privacy.s7Body: This policy may be updated from time to time; significant changes will be announced on this page. If you have any questions about this policy, please reach us via the contact page.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to WorldFlavors. By accessing or using this website, you acknowledge that you have read, understood and agree to be bound by these Terms of Service.
terms.s1Body: Please read these terms carefully before using the site. If you do not agree with any part of them, please stop using the website. We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time; modifications take effect once published.
terms.s2Body: This website provides global food culture content, including free recipes, premium paid recipes and membership subscriptions. Some features are in planning or testing phases; actual functionality is as presented on the pages.
terms.s3Body: Certain features (planned) may require an account. You are responsible for the accuracy of your account information and all activities under your account, and for keeping your credentials secure. Notify us immediately of any unauthorized use.
terms.s4Body: Paid recipes and memberships are digital content goods. Please review the content preview before purchase; delivery is considered complete upon successful payment. See our Refund Policy for details.
terms.s5Body: All text, images, logos and other content on this site are owned by WorldFlavors or the respective rights holders. No content may be copied, reproduced or used commercially without permission.
terms.s6Body: Recipes are provided for reference only; actual results vary with ingredients, equipment and technique. Choose ingredients according to your own health conditions and allergies. We are not liable for any outcomes from following the recipes.
terms.s7Body: Any changes to these terms will be posted on this page. If you have questions about these terms, please reach us via the contact page.
terms.contactNote: For questions about these terms, contact us:

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.intro: This Refund Policy applies to paid recipes and membership subscriptions on WorldFlavors. Given the nature of digital content, please read this policy carefully before purchasing.
refund.s1Body: Products sold on this site are digital content (recipes and membership benefits), delivered via instant online unlock. Once delivered, digital content is generally non-refundable, except in the cases below.
refund.s2Body: A single recipe unlocks immediately after payment and cannot be refunded once unlocked. If a system error prevents the content from unlocking after a successful payment, we will restore access or issue a full refund after verification.
refund.s3Body: Within 7 days of purchase, a full refund is available if no member-exclusive content has been used. After 7 days, or if membership benefits have been used, refunds are negotiated pro-rata. Lifetime memberships are non-refundable after 7 days as content is delivered continuously.
refund.s4Body: To request a refund, submit your order information and reason via the contact page. We review requests within 3 business days; approved refunds are returned via the original payment method within 7 business days.
refund.s5Body: We reserve the right to refuse refunds in cases of: fraudulent, abusive or bad-faith refund activity; account sharing or content resale; or account suspension due to violations of the Terms of Service.
refund.s6Body: If you have any questions about this policy or a refund request, please reach us via the contact page — we are happy to help.
refund.contactNote: For refund requests and inquiries, contact us:
